title: This purple electric Chinese minivan can go up to 559 miles on a charge
description: Electric minivans could be the ultimate in utility, with room for passengers, gear, and huge batteries. While VW's ID Buzz only gave us 200 miles of real-world driving on a charge in 2023, China's BYD has just announced a flagship purple peoplemover that can go an estimated 559 miles (900 km) on electricity.
